name: menubar
title: Menubar
description: A row of menus, as at the top of a desktop window, on Base UI's Menubar: titles that open DropdownMenu-style menus (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus), moving between menus with the arrow keys or the pointer once one is open.

manifest.name: menubar
manifest.title: Menubar
manifest.description: A row of menus, as at the top of a desktop window, on Base UI's Menubar: titles that open DropdownMenu-style menus (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus), moving between menus with the arrow keys or the pointer once one is open.
manifest.usage: Use Menubar for an application's menu row in a web build, where the window has no native menu: File, Query, View, Help. Compose it as Menubar > MenubarMenu (one per menu) > MenubarTrigger (the title) + MenubarContent > MenubarItem (MenubarShortcut at the end; danger for a destructive one), MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarRadioGroup with MenubarRadioItem, MenubarGroup with MenubarLabel, MenubarSeparator, MenubarSub > MenubarSubTrigger + MenubarSubContent. Keep the commands also in the CommandPalette. On the desktop prefer the native menu; for one menu behind a button use DropdownMenu; for site navigation (links) use NavigationMenu.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Menubar: the direction of the row, and of the arrow keys that move along it.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Menubar: the arrow keys wrap from the last title to the first.

props.name: modal
props.description: Menubar: while a menu is open the page ignores the pointer and does not scroll.

props.name: open
props.description: MenubarMenu: controlled open state; defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: MenubarMenu: called when its title, an item, Escape or an outside press opens or closes it.

props.name: danger
props.description: MenubarItem: a destructive action in color.status.danger.fg.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: MenubarItem: closes the menu when chosen (false for checkbox and radio items by default).

props.name: disabled
props.description: On an item: shown in color.fg.disabled with aria-disabled; it cannot be chosen.

props.name: checked
props.description: MenubarCheckboxItem: controlled state; onCheckedChange reports changes.

props.name: value
props.description: MenubarRadioGroup: the chosen value (onValueChange); MenubarRadioItem: its value.

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: role="menubar", a row on color.bg.surface with a border; data-slot="menubar".

slots.name: positioner
slots.description: In a portal under the title, at z.popover, with the row's data-theme and data-density; data-slot="menubar-positioner".

parts.name: MenubarTrigger
parts.description: A menu's title in the row (role="menuitem", aria-haspopup="menu"), in type.label; color.interactive.hover while hovered or open.

parts.name: MenubarContent
parts.description: The portal, the positioner under the title and the menu.

parts.name: MenubarItem
parts.description: role="menuitem"; color.interactive.hover while highlighted; data-danger for a destructive one.

parts.name: MenubarCheckboxItem
parts.description: role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and a check mark.

parts.name: MenubarRadioGroup
parts.description: role="group" holding the radio items; value and onValueChange.

parts.name: MenubarRadioItem
parts.description: role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked and a dot.

parts.name: MenubarLabel
parts.description: A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.

parts.name: MenubarSeparator
parts.description: role="separator", a 1 px line in color.border.default.

parts.name: MenubarShortcut
parts.description: The shortcut at the end of an item, in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.

parts.name: MenubarSubTrigger
parts.description: An item that opens a submenu (aria-haspopup), with a chevron; color.interactive.hover while its submenu is open.

parts.name: MenubarSubContent
parts.description: The submenu's popup, beside its trigger.

states.name: hover
states.description: A title under the pointer: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on a title: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: open
states.description: Opening: the menu grows from 95 % at the trigger and fades in over motion.duration.base with motion.easing.enter; reduced motion turns it off.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: The item under the pointer or the keyboard: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: submenu-open
states.description: A title whose menu is open, or a sub-trigger whose submenu is open, keeps color.interactive.hover.

states.name: danger
states.description: A destructive item: color.status.danger.fg, color.status.danger.bg when highlighted.

states.name: disabled
states.description: A disabled item: color.fg.disabled and aria-disabled; reachable but not chosen.

accessibility: The row is role="menubar"; each title is role="menuitem" with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded; each popup is role="menu" of menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items.

One title is in the tab order; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between titles (wrapping), Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens a menu with its first item highlighted; while a menu is open ArrowLeft and ArrowRight open the neighbouring menu; Escape closes and returns focus to the title.
Inside a menu: arrows, Home, End and typing move, Enter chooses; ArrowRight on a sub-trigger opens its submenu. Disabled items stay reachable but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen.
Once one menu is open, moving the pointer over another title opens that menu.
Titles have a visible focus ring; prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the menus' scale and fade off.
Every command is also in the CommandPalette with its shortcut.

meta.example:
import {
  Menubar,
  MenubarCheckboxItem,
  MenubarContent,
  MenubarGroup,
  MenubarItem,
  MenubarLabel,
  MenubarMenu,
  MenubarRadioGroup,
  MenubarRadioItem,
  MenubarSeparator,
  MenubarShortcut,
  MenubarSub,
  MenubarSubContent,
  MenubarSubTrigger,
  MenubarTrigger,
} from "@/components/menubar/menubar";

/** The smallest useful Menubar: two menus. */
export function MenubarMinimal() {
  return (
    <Menubar>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarItem>New query tab</MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem>Close tab</MenubarItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>Help</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarItem>About DBee</MenubarItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
    </Menubar>
  );
}

/**
 * A web build's menu row (the desktop keeps the native one): shortcuts, a recent-files submenu,
 * view options as checkbox and radio items, a disabled and a destructive action.
 */
export function MenubarRealistic() {
  return (
    <Menubar>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarItem>
            New query tab <MenubarShortcut>Alt+Shift+T</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem>
            Add connection <MenubarShortcut>Ctrl+Alt+N</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarSub>
            <MenubarSubTrigger>Open recent</MenubarSubTrigger>
            <MenubarSubContent>
              <MenubarItem>orders-by-region.sql</MenubarItem>
              <MenubarItem>vacuum-report.sql</MenubarItem>
            </MenubarSubContent>
          </MenubarSub>
          <MenubarSeparator />
          <MenubarItem>
            Export result <MenubarShortcut>Ctrl+Shift+S</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem danger>
            Close tab <MenubarShortcut>Alt+Shift+W</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>Query</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarItem>
            Run statement <MenubarShortcut>Ctrl+Enter</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem disabled>
            Cancel <MenubarShortcut>Shift+Escape</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarCheckboxItem defaultChecked>Sidebar</MenubarCheckboxItem>
          <MenubarCheckboxItem>Status bar</MenubarCheckboxItem>
          <MenubarSeparator />
          <MenubarGroup>
            <MenubarLabel>Density</MenubarLabel>
            <MenubarRadioGroup defaultValue="compact">
              <MenubarRadioItem value="compact">Compact</MenubarRadioItem>
              <MenubarRadioItem value="comfortable">Comfortable</MenubarRadioItem>
            </MenubarRadioGroup>
          </MenubarGroup>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
    </Menubar>
  );
}
